name: Amplify Worn Magic Item (Item Mastery)
body:
You increase the skill bonuses granted to you by magic items.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Choose one type of worn magic item, such as belt slot items or shoulder slot items. When this item grants you a bonus to a skill, the bonus is increased by 2.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times. Each time, it applies to a different type of worn magic item.
